SELECT ps.participant_id, ps.agreement_service_id FROM public.health_examination_participant_services ps JOIN public.health_examination_participants p ON p.agreement_id=ps.agreement_id AND p.id=ps.participant_id WHERE ps.agreement_id=#{agreementId} AND ps.is_performed AND p.roster_status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY ps.participant_id, ps.agreement_service_id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS registered, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ()='UNCONFIRMED') AS unconfirmed, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE asg.attended_count > 0) AS attended, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ()='NO_SHOW') AS no_show, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE asg.live_count = 0) AS unscheduled, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.service_reconciliation_status='RECONCILED') AS reconciled, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE asg.attended_count > 0 AND p.service_reconciliation_status='PENDING') AS pending_reconciliation FROM public.health_examination_participants p

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS sessions, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status='ATTENDED') AS visits FROM public.health_examination_session_assignments a JOIN public.health_examination_sessions s ON s.id=a.session_id JOIN public.health_examination_participants p ON p.id=a.participant_id WHERE AND a.status IN ('ASSIGNED','ATTENDED') AND s.session_date >= #{from} AND s.session_date <= #{to}

SELECT ps.agreement_service_id, ps.unit_price_snapshot AS unit_price, COUNT(*) AS examined_count FROM public.health_examination_participant_services ps JOIN public.health_examination_participants p ON p.agreement_id=ps.agreement_id AND p.id=ps.participant_id WHERE ps.is_performed AND GROUP BY ps.agreement_service_id, ps.unit_price_snapshot ORDER BY ps.agreement_service_id, ps.unit_price_snapshot
